text: A Call to Arms is a quest given by Otho that takes place in Grit Gate, where the player must fight the Putus Templar. It can only begin after completing The Earl of Omonporch.
A Canticle for Barathrum is handed to the player by Argyve and unfolds in Grit Gate, sending them to find Otho. It requires completing Weirdwire Conduit... Eureka! beforehand.

Argyve is of the Mutated Human race and lives in Joppa, where he serves as a low-tier merchant. He is a member of the Barathrumites and is liked by the Barathrumites. Argyve gives the player the quests A Canticle for Barathrum and Weirdwire Conduit... Eureka!. He has 150 HP and is level 22.
Asphodel Earl of Omonporch is of the Sentient Plant race and dwells in Omonporch. He is the target the player must find in the quest The Earl of Omonporch. He has 500 HP and is level 30.
Baetyl inhabits the Temple of the Rock and is the objective sought during Decoding the Signal. It has 2000 HP and is level 25.

Barathrum the Old is of the Urshiib race and lives in Grit Gate. He is a member of the Barathrumites and a member of the Seraphic Covenant, and the Barathrumites hold him in high regard. He gives the player the quests Reclamation, The Golem, Tomb of the Eaters, We Are Starfreight, and Pax Qlanq, I Presume?.

The Barathrumites count Argyve, Barathrum the Old, Golem, Otho, and Sparafucile among their members. They like Argyve, Barathrum the Old, Kun, and Otho, but they hate the Girsh, the Mechanimists, and the Putus Templar.
Bethesda Susa is a place at strata 0 that contains the settlement Temple of the Rock. Its inhabitants include Saad Amus and the alchemist, and it hosts the quest Decoding the Signal.
Copper Wire is an item the player must locate during Weirdwire Conduit... Eureka!. Its value is 0 drams and its weight is 0.

Decoding the Signal is a quest given by Otho that takes place in Bethesda Susa and in the Temple of the Rock. It pits the player against the Mechanimists and asks them to find Baetyl, and it requires completing More Than a Willing Spirit.
Eaters' Tomb is a place at strata 0 inhabited by Herodododicus, and it hosts the quest Tomb of the Eaters.
The Fungi race counts Pax Qlanq among its members.

The Girsh faction dislikes Kun and is fought in the quest Reclamation. It counts Starformed Ehalcodon as a member, and it hates the Barathrumites, the Mechanimists, the Putus Templar, and the Villagers of Joppa.
The Girsh Nephilim race counts Starformed Ehalcodon among its members.
Golem lives in Grit Gate, is a member of the Barathrumites, and serves as a non-boss Fighter. It has 350 HP and is level 50.
Golgotha is a place at strata 0 inhabited by Slog of the Cloaca, and it hosts the quest More Than a Willing Spirit.
Grit Gate is a settlement at strata 3 whose inhabitants include Barathrum the Old, Golem, Otho, and Sparafucile. It hosts the quests A Call to Arms, A Canticle for Barathrum, and The Golem.
Herodododicus inhabits Eaters' Tomb and is the target the player must find during Tomb of the Eaters. He has 150 HP and is level 26.
Joppa is a settlement at strata 0 whose inhabitants include Argyve.
Joppa Recoiler is the item awarded as a reward for Weirdwire Conduit... Eureka!. Its value is 25 drams and its weight is 1.
Kun is the player character, who spawns in Joppa. Kun is disliked by the Girsh and disliked by the Putus Templar, but liked by the Barathrumites.
The Mechanimists are fought in the quest Decoding the Signal. They count Phinae Hoshaiah High Priest of the Rock as a member and they like Reseph.
The Mollusk race counts Slog of the Cloaca among its members.

More Than a Willing Spirit is a quest given by Otho that takes place in Golgotha, asking the player to find the Scrapped Waydroid. It rewards the player with Sparafucile's Carbine and requires completing A Canticle for Barathrum.
The Mutated Human race counts Argyve, Phinae Hoshaiah High Priest of the Rock, and the alchemist among its members.
Omonporch is a place at strata 0 inhabited by Asphodel Earl of Omonporch. It hosts the quests Reclamation, The Earl of Omonporch, and We Are Starfreight.

Otho is of the Urshiib race and lives in Grit Gate, where he is a member of the Barathrumites and liked by the Barathrumites. He gives the player the quests A Call to Arms, Decoding the Signal, More Than a Willing Spirit, and The Earl of Omonporch, and he is sought during A Canticle for Barathrum. He has 95 HP and is level 28.
Pax Qlanq is of the Fungi race and inhabits Rainbow Wood. Pax Qlanq is the target the player must find during Pax Qlanq, I Presume?. He has 300 HP and is level 30.

Pax Qlanq, I Presume? is a quest given by Barathrum the Old that takes place in Rainbow Wood, asking the player to find Pax Qlanq. It rewards the player with a quantum mote and requires completing A Call to Arms.

Phinae Hoshaiah High Priest of the Rock is of the Mutated Human race and inhabits the Temple of the Rock, where he is a member of the Mechanimists and serves as a boss-tier Fighter. He has 225 HP and is level 20.
The Putus Templar dislike Kun and are fought in the quests A Call to Arms and Reclamation. They hate the Barathrumites, the Girsh, and the Mechanimists.
Rainbow Wood is a place at strata 0 inhabited by Pax Qlanq, and it hosts the quest Pax Qlanq, I Presume?.
Reclamation is a quest given by Barathrum the Old that takes place in Omonporch, where the player fights the Girsh, the Putus Templar, and Starformed Ehalcodon. It requires completing The Golem.
Reseph inhabits Starfarers' Quay and is a member of the Seraphic Covenant. Reseph is liked by the Mechanimists and is the target sought during We Are Starfreight. He has 4000 HP and is level 100.
Rust Wells is a place at strata 3 that hosts the quest Weirdwire Conduit... Eureka!.
Saad Amus inhabits Bethesda Susa, where he serves as a boss-tier Fighter. He has 350 HP and is level 35.
Scrapped Waydroid is the item the player must find during More Than a Willing Spirit. Its value is 0 drams and its weight is 1.
The Sentient Plant race counts Asphodel Earl of Omonporch among its members.
The Seraphic Covenant counts Barathrum the Old and Reseph among its members.
Slog of the Cloaca is of the Mollusk race and inhabits Golgotha, where he serves as a boss-tier Fighter. He has 150 HP and is level 17.
Sparafucile is of the Urshiib race and lives in Grit Gate, where he works as a mid-tier merchant and is a member of the Barathrumites. He has 95 HP and is level 24.
Sparafucile's Carbine is the item awarded as a reward for More Than a Willing Spirit. Its value is 200 drams and its weight is 10.
Starfarers' Quay is a place at strata 0 inhabited by Reseph, and it hosts the quest We Are Starfreight.
Starformed Ehalcodon is of the Girsh Nephilim race and is a member of the Girsh, and it serves as a boss-tier Fighter. It is fought in the quest Reclamation. It has 12000 HP and is level 60.

Temple of the Rock is a settlement at strata 16 located in the place Bethesda Susa. Its inhabitants include Baetyl and Phinae Hoshaiah High Priest of the Rock, and it hosts the quest Decoding the Signal.
The Earl of Omonporch is a quest given by Otho that takes place in Omonporch, asking the player to find Asphodel Earl of Omonporch. It requires completing Decoding the Signal.
The Golem is a quest given by Barathrum the Old that takes place in Grit Gate, asking the player to find neutron flux. It requires completing Tomb of the Eaters.

Tomb of the Eaters is a quest given by Barathrum the Old that takes place in Eaters' Tomb, asking the player to find Herodododicus. It rewards the player with metamorphic polygel and requires completing Pax Qlanq, I Presume?.
The Urshiib race counts Barathrum the Old, Otho, and Sparafucile among its members.
The Villagers of Joppa hate the Girsh.
We Are Starfreight is a quest given by Barathrum the Old that takes place in Omonporch and at Starfarers' Quay, asking the player to find Reseph. It requires completing Reclamation.
Weirdwire Conduit... Eureka! is a quest given by Argyve that takes place in Rust Wells, asking the player to find Copper Wire. It rewards the player with the Joppa Recoiler.
The alchemist is of the Mutated Human race and inhabits Bethesda Susa, where they work as a high-tier merchant. They have 175 HP and are level 30.
Metamorphic polygel is the item awarded as a reward for Tomb of the Eaters. Its value is 600 drams and its weight is 1.
Neutron flux is the item the player must find during The Golem. Its value is 1000 drams and its weight is 1.
A quantum mote is the item awarded as a reward for Pax Qlanq, I Presume?.
